Three people were booked into the Webb County Jail overnight on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records.

Sulema Dalia Sanchez (Booking #202608916) was arrested early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 1:20 a.m. and booked on one count of CRIMINAL TRESPASS — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging entering or remaining on someone else's property after being told to leave — filed under Case #PFCC26-003318L1. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists her city as Laredo, Texas.

Andres Guajardo (Booking #202608915) was arrested early Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 1:15 a.m. and booked on one count of CRIMINAL TRESPASS — a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging entering or remaining on someone else's property after being told to leave — filed under Case #PFCC26-003317L2. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists his city as Laredo, Texas.

Yailine Navarro (Booking #202608914) was arrested Tuesday night, October 20, 2026, at 8:39 p.m. and booked on one count of VIOL BOND/PROTECTIVE ORDER — a Class A misdemeanor under Texas law, alleging violation of a bond condition or a protective order — filed under Case #PFCC26-003316L2. Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. She was arrested by the Laredo Police Department, per the Odyssey jail search; the record lists her city as Rio Bravo, Texas.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Sulema Dalia Sanchez, Andres Guajardo, and Yailine Navarro are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Bookings #202608916, #202608915, and #202608914, Oct. 21, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
